_readme: Consulting offers shown on the home page. Keep it to five; more dilutes the pitch. 'deliverables' should be concrete nouns a client receives, not activities. 'other' is the closing tile for work that doesn't fit a card.
intro: Whether you need something built, the right tools and AI adopted, or what you already have tested before launch: I bring ten years of C++ and Python engineering to it, and I explain it in plain language. Every engagement starts with a short call to check the fit.

items.title: Custom software development
items.summary: Software built around how your business actually works — internal tools, automations, integrations, and full applications. Written in C++, Python, or TypeScript, depending on what the job needs, with the same rigor I used shipping code for seven years at John Deere.
deliverables: A working application, tool, or automation — deployed and in use
Tested code and CI/CD, so every change stays safe to ship
Documentation and a handover session, so you're never locked in

items.title: Software & AI adoption
items.summary: Choosing the right tools — and AI — for your workflow, then setting them up so your team actually uses them. No hype: I start with where the hours are lost, then connect off-the-shelf software, AI assistants, and custom glue only where it pays off.
deliverables: A short audit: where time goes, and which tools or AI can win it back
Tools and AI assistants set up and connected to your existing systems, with cost and privacy in check
Training and written guides, so your team keeps using them

items.title: Testing & QA
items.summary: Finding the bugs before your customers do. I've built test automation for release pipelines and simulators so teams could test without waiting on hardware — the same discipline applies to your web app, API, or desktop software.
deliverables: A test plan focused on what matters most to your users
Automated tests (Python, Google Test, end-to-end) wired into your CI
A pre-launch report: what's broken, what's risky, and what to fix first

items.title: Web design & development
items.summary: Websites and web apps that look professional and bring in business — from a marketing site to a full product with logins and a database. Fast, mobile-friendly, and easy for you to update.
deliverables: A design you approve before development starts
A fast, responsive site or app (React, Astro), live on your domain
Basic SEO, analytics, and a way to edit content yourself

items.title: Technical & engineering leadership
items.summary: A part-time tech lead or engineering manager for your team. I've supervised 10+ engineers across 5 clients, run Scrum and PSI planning, and built the hiring and onboarding process for a growing team.
deliverables: Sprint cadence, rituals, and stakeholder reporting that stick
Hiring loops, interview guides, and an onboarding plan
Code review, architecture guidance, and career mentoring for your engineers

other.title: Something else?
other.summary: If it can be solved with software, let's talk. Tell me the problem — not the solution — and I'll tell you honestly whether I'm the right person for it.
